summary: wire into /api/query (persist cost_usd + cached_input_tokens) + /api/quota (return both axes)
description:
Wire the new cost/budget plumbing into the API surface.

src/app/api/query/route.ts:
  Before the LLM call:
    - estimate input tokens (rough: prompt char count / 4 or use the embedded token counts from buildPrompt)
    - estimatedCostUsd = computeCost({ modelId, inputTokens: est, outputTokens: MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS, cachedInputTokens: 0 })
    - reserveBudget({ userId, tier, estimatedCostUsd }) — abort with 429 + Retry-After if rejected, including reason
  After the stream finishes:
    - Read actual usage from the OpenAI streaming usage chunk (already opted in via stream_options.include_usage)
    - actualCostUsd = computeCost({ modelId, inputTokens, outputTokens, cachedInputTokens, at: now })
    - finalizeBudget({ userId, estimatedCostUsd, actualCostUsd })
    - Persist queries row WITH cost_usd and cached_input_tokens populated
  Existing fields keep their meaning — model_used, tier_used, input_tokens, output_tokens unchanged.

src/app/api/quota/route.ts:
  Return shape becomes:
    { tier, queries_used, query_limit, usd_used, usd_limit }
  Frontend (account/page.tsx, nav-bar.tsx, chat-view.tsx) already reads .tier and the query fields; the new dollar fields are additive — UI keeps showing 'X of N queries' until a separate UI ticket flips the display.

Tests (extend src/__tests__/api.test.ts):
- successful query persists cost_usd + cached_input_tokens
- 429 path: rate limit hit → reserveBudget never called, no usd_used delta
- LLM stream reports a 'usage' chunk with cached tokens → persisted correctly
- LLM stream truncates without usage → cost_usd may be NULL or computed from estimate (decide: NULL is honest)
- /api/quota response includes both axes

Done when:
- /api/query writes the new fields
- /api/quota returns both axes
- Existing tests still pass; new ones for the cost-persistence path land
- Manual smoke: send a query, confirm queries.cost_usd is non-null and matches OpenRouter dashboard within rounding

resolution.note: /api/query writes cost_usd + cached_input_tokens, calls reserveBudget pre-flight and finalizeBudget post-stream. /api/quota returns both axes. quota.ts deleted; everything routes through spend.ts + cost.ts.
